specification.text:
type ActivityEntry {
  """
  USD price when available; legacy records retain whole dollars, transfers retain quantities.
  """
  amount: String!
  artwork: Artwork!
  asset: Asset
  assetType: AssetType!
  currencyAmount: String
  currencySymbol: String
  edition: Edition
  entryType: ActivityEntryType!
  fromBlockchainAddress: String
  fromEthereumAddress: EthereumAddress
  fromUserId: UserPublic
  id: ID!
  offerId: ID
  quantity: String
  timestamp: Time!
  toBlockchainAddress: String
  toEthereumAddress: EthereumAddress
  toUserId: UserPublic
  transactionHash: String
}

type ActivityEntryConnection {
  nodes: [ActivityEntry!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
}

enum ActivityEntryType {
  NEW_FLOOR_PRICE
  ONCHAIN_BURN
  ONCHAIN_MINT
  ONCHAIN_SALE
  ONCHAIN_TRANSFER
  OS_COLLECTION_OFFER
  OS_LISTED
  OS_OFFER
  OS_SALE
  PM_SALE
  SM_DELISTED
  SM_GLOBAL_OFFER
  SM_LISTED
  SM_OFFER
  SM_SALE
}

input ActivityPageFilter {
  activityType: [ActivityEntryType!]
  addresses: [String!]
  artworkId: ID
  artworkIds: [ID!]
  assetIds: [ID!]
  assetType: AssetType

  """
  Filter sales by confirmed Verse checkout attribution. True includes native primary/secondary sales and matched on-chain sales; false includes checked on-chain sales without a Verse checkout. Unclassified historical records match neither. Omit for all activity.
  """
  executedOnVerse: Boolean
  tags: TagsFilter
  userId: ID
}

union AdditionalSecondaryMarketStrategy = SMBuyNowStrategy

type Amount {
  currency: String!
  value: Decimal!
}

type ArtblocksProjectArtworkKind {
  allowUserCuration: Boolean
  artblocksProjectId: Int!
  aspectRatio: Float!
  iframeUrl: String!
  showStaticPreview: Boolean
}

type Artwork {
  artist: Person
  artworkKind: ArtworkKind
  banner: StaticAsset
  bestOffer: MarketplaceOrder
  blockchain: ProductChain!
  collection: Collection
  contractAddress: String
  cover: StaticAsset
  description: Markdown
  displayStyle: DisplayStyle!
  expectedSaleDate: Time

  """Traits of the artwork's editions. At most `first` traits when given."""
  features(first: Int): [Feature!]
  floorListing: MarketplaceOrder
  id: ArtworkID!
  isHidden: Boolean!
  license: String
  osSlug: String
  primaryMarketListing: PrimaryMarketListing
  requiresShippingDetails: Boolean!
  saleDetails: String
  saleType: ArtworkSaleType!
  secondaryMarketDisabled: Boolean!
  secondaryMarketSaleWithPhysical: Boolean!
  title: String
  updatedAt: Time
  year: String
}

type ArtworkConnection {
  nodes: [Artwork!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int
}

scalar ArtworkID

union ArtworkKind = ArtblocksProjectArtworkKind | GenerativeProjectArtworkKind | ProjectArtworkKind | QuasiDragonsCompositeArtworkKind

enum ArtworkSaleType {
  NOTFORSALE
  PRIVATE
  REGULAR
  SILENT
}

type ArtworkVolume {
  artwork: Artwork!
  openseaSales: Int!
  openseaVolume: String!
  primarySales: Int!
  primaryVolume: String!
  secondarySales: Int!
  secondaryVolume: String!
  totalSales: Int!
  totalVolume: String!
}

input ArtworksPageFilter {
  collectionIds: [ID!]
  containsTags: [String!]
  ids: [ID!]
  notContainsTags: [String!]
  search: String
  showHidden: Boolean
}

input ArtworksPageRequest {
  after: Cursor
  filter: ArtworksPageFilter
  first: Int! = 20
}

type Asset {
  """The edition's artwork. Null for bookmarks."""
  artwork: Artwork
  asset: AssetPrimitive!
  assetType: AssetType!
  creator: UserPublic
  id: ID!

  """
  Effective last-transfer time used by owner-filtered LAST_TRANSFERRED_AT asset pages.
  Null outside that page context or when the acquisition time is unknown.
  """
  lastTransferredAt: Time
  smListing: SecondaryMarketListing
  stats: EditionStats!
}

input AssetAdvancedFeatureFilter {
  bool: AssetFilterFeatureBool
  exists: AssetFilterFeatureExists
  filter: AssetFilterFeature
}

type AssetConnection {
  nodes: [Asset!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int!
}

input AssetFilter {
  advancedFeatures: AssetAdvancedFeatureFilter
  artistIds: [ID!]
  artworkIds: [ID!]
  assetType: AssetType! = EDITION
  availability: [AssetFilterAvailabilityOption!]
  excludeCollectionTags: [String!]
  features: [AssetFilterFeature!]
  hashes: [String!]
  ids: [ID!]
  includeCollectionTags: [String!]
  owners: [AssetFilterOwner!]
  search: String
}

enum AssetFilterAvailabilityOption {
  ACCEPTING_OFFERS
  BUY_NOW
}

input AssetFilterFeature {
  name: String!
  value: String!
}

input AssetFilterFeatureBool {
  must: [AssetAdvancedFeatureFilter!]
  mustNot: [AssetAdvancedFeatureFilter!]
  should: [AssetAdvancedFeatureFilter!]
}

input AssetFilterFeatureExists {
  name: String!
}

input AssetFilterOwner {
  blockchainAddress: String
  userId: String
}

input AssetInput {
  assetId: ID!
  assetType: AssetType!
}

union AssetPrimitive = Bookmark | Edition

enum AssetSortOption {
  CREATED_AT
  EDITION_NUMBER
  LAST_SALE_PRICE
  LAST_SALE_TIME
  LAST_TRANSFERRED_AT
  LISTED_AT
  LIST_PRICE
  TITLE
}

input AssetSorting {
  direction: SortDirection!
  sort: AssetSortOption!
}

enum AssetType {
  BOOKMARK
  EDITION
}

type AudioAsset implements IStaticAsset {
  baseUrlTemplate: String!
  duration: Float
  fileSize: Int
  id: StaticAssetID!
  mimeType: String
}

type BitcoinProductAddress implements BlockchainAddress {
  address: String!
}

interface BlockchainAddress {
  address: String!
}

type BlockchainAddressEditionOwner {
  blockchainAddress: EthereumAddress!
}

type Bookmark {

}

enum Chain {
  BASE
  BITCOIN
  ETHEREUM
  NOT_SPECIFIED
  SEPOLIA
  SHAPE
  SOLANA
  TEZOS
}

type Collection {
  banner: StaticAsset

  license: String

  year: String

type CollectionConnection {
  nodes: [Collection!]!

  totalCount: Int
}

type CollectionVolume {
  collection: Collection!
  openseaSales: Int!
  openseaVolume: String!
  primarySales: Int!
  primaryVolume: String!
  secondarySales: Int!
  secondaryVolume: String!

}

input CollectionsPageFilter {
  containsTags: [String!]
  ids: [ID!]
  notContainsTags: [String!]
  search: String
  showHidden: Boolean
  slugs: [String!]
}

input CollectionsPageRequest {
  after: Cursor
  filter: CollectionsPageFilter

}

type ContractInfo {
  chain: ProductChain!
  contractAddress: String!
  contractType: ContractType!
}

enum ContractType {
  ARTBLOCKS
  CRYPTOPUNKS
  ERC_721
  ERC_721_CURATED
  ERC_721v3
  ERC_721v3_CUSTOM_v1
  ERC_721v3_ON_CHAIN
  ERC_1155
  ERC_1155_BALANCE_BACKED
  ERC_1155v2
  SOLANA
  TEZOS_CUSTOM_v1
  TEZOS_FXHASH
  TEZOS_OBJKT
}

scalar Cursor

scalar Decimal

type DecreasingSupplySettings {
  decreaseBy: Int!
  decreaseRateSeconds: Int!
  nextDecreaseAt: Time
}

enum DisplayStyle {
  DisplayRegular
  DisplayWide
}

type DutchAuctionSettings {
  currentBracket: Decimal
  decreaseRateSeconds: Int!
  nextBracketAt: Time
  rebate: Boolean!
}

type Edition {
  artwork: Artwork!
  artworkId: ID!
  asset: Asset!
  bestOffer: MarketplaceOrder
  contractInfo: ContractInfo
  createdAt: Time!
  description: String

  """
  № of Edition. To show a person something like "you own Edition #4 of 20"
  Assets service deduct edition number on its own, based on how many editions there are for primaryMarketListingId
  """
  editionNumber: Int!
  features: [FeatureValue!]

  """Cheapest active ask on the edition."""
  floorListing: MarketplaceOrder
  hash: String
  id: ID!
  isBalanceBacked: Boolean!
  mintingOptionType: MintingOptionType!
  osListing: OpenseaListing

  """
  For balance-backed editions the stored owner columns freeze at import time
  (often on a marketplace escrow contract), so ownership is resolved from the
  balance-backed ownership projection instead. Other editions serve the
  stored owner as before.
  """
  owner: EditionOwner!
  primaryMarketListingId: ID!

  """smListing would be null if edition was withdrawn"""
  smListing: SecondaryMarketListing
  staticAsset: StaticAsset
  stats: EditionStats!
  status: EditionStatus!
  title: String

  """
  ID of Edition on the blockchain. Assets service generate this field on its own
  """
  tokenId: String
}

union EditionOwner = BlockchainAddressEditionOwner | UserEditionOwner

type EditionStats {
  lastSalePrice: Amount
  lastSaleTime: Time
}

enum EditionStatus {
  BURNED
  DEPOSIT_REQUESTED
  MINTING
  NOT_MINTED
  ON_PLATFORM
  WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED
  WITHDRAWING
  WITHDRAWN
}

type EthereumAddress implements BlockchainAddress {
  address: String!
  ensName: String
}

type Exhibition {
  about: Markdown
  contentBanner: StaticAsset
  cover: ImageAsset
  endDate: Time
  id: ExhibitionID!
  isHidden: Boolean!
  keyDetails: String
  name: String
  slug: String!
  startDate: Time
  subtitle: String
  tags: [String!]!
  updatedAt: Time
}

type ExhibitionConnection {
  nodes: [Exhibition!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int
}

scalar ExhibitionID

input ExhibitionsPageFilter {
  containsTags: [String!]
  ids: [ID!]
  notContainsTags: [String!]
  personIds: [PersonID!]
  search: String
  slugs: [String!]
}

input ExhibitionsPageRequest {
  after: Cursor
  filter: ExhibitionsPageFilter
  first: Int! = 20
}

input ExploreFilter {
  artistIds: [PersonID!]
  assetType: [ExploreFilterAssetType!]
  containsTags: [String!]
  exploreTab: [ExploreTabFilter!]
  market: [ExploreFilterMarket!]
  notContainsTags: [String!]
  personIds: [PersonID!]
}

enum ExploreFilterAssetType {
  IMAGE
  OTHER
  VIDEO
}

enum ExploreFilterMarket {
  PRIMARY
  SECONDARY
}

enum ExploreSortOption {
  ENDED_AT
  FEATURED_SCORE
  FLOOR_PRICE
  LAST_SALE_TIME
  RECENCY
  UPCOMING
}

input ExploreSorting {
  direction: SortDirection!
  sort: ExploreSortOption!
}

enum ExploreTabFilter {
  CLOSED
  CLOSING_SOON
  LIVE
  OPEN
  UPCOMING
}

type ExtensionSettings {
  extendUpToMsec: Int!
  extensionCutoff: Time
}

union Feature = StringFeature

interface FeatureInterface {
  name: String!
  totalEntries: Int!
}

union FeatureValue = StringFeatureValue

interface FeatureValueInterface {
  name: String!
  valueJson: String!
}

type FeeEstimation {
  marketplaceAmount: Amount!
  marketplaceFee: Decimal!
  royaltyAmount: Amount!
  royaltyFee: Decimal!
  youWillReceive: Amount!
}

input GalleriesPageFilter {
  ids: [ID!]
  search: String
  slugs: [String!]
}

input GalleriesPageRequest {
  after: Cursor
  filter: GalleriesPageFilter
  first: Int! = 20
}

type Gallery {
  bio: Markdown
  cover: ImageAsset
  establishedAt: Time
  id: GalleryID!
  name: String
  slug: String!
  updatedAt: Time
}

type GalleryConnection {
  nodes: [Gallery!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int
}

scalar GalleryID

type GenerativeProjectArtworkKind {
  allowUserCuration: Boolean
  aspectRatio: Float!
  iframeUrl: String!
  showStaticPreview: Boolean
}

type IFrameAsset implements IStaticAsset {
  aspectRatio: Float
  baseUrlTemplate: String!
  caption: String
  id: StaticAssetID!
  iframeUrl: String!
  previewImageUrlTemplate: String!
}

interface IStaticAsset {
  baseUrlTemplate: String!
  id: StaticAssetID!
}

type ImageAsset implements IStaticAsset {
  aspectRatio: Float
  author: String
  baseUrlTemplate: String!
  caption: String
  fileSize: Int
  height: Int
  id: StaticAssetID!
  isGif: Boolean!
  mimeType: String
  width: Int
}

input InputAmount {
  currency: String!
  value: Decimal!
}

type Link {
  categories: [LinkCategory!]!
  date: Time
  excerpt: String
  id: LinkID!
  imageAsset: ImageAsset
  imageUrl: String
  title: String
  url: String
}

enum LinkCategory {
  INTERVIEW
  NEWS
  PODCAST
  VIDEO
}

type LinkConnection {
  nodes: [Link!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int
}

scalar LinkID

type LinkedWallet {
  address: String!
  network: LinkedWalletNetwork!
  userId: ID!
}

enum LinkedWalletNetwork {
  Bitcoin
  Ethereum
  Solana
  Tezos
}

input LinksPageFilter {
  ids: [ID!]
  search: String
}

input LinksPageRequest {
  after: Cursor
  filter: LinksPageFilter
  first: Int! = 20
}

scalar Markdown

enum Market {
  ONCHAIN
  OPENSEA
  PRIMARY
  SECONDARY
}

type MarketplaceOrder {
  artwork: Artwork
  asset: Asset
  chain: Chain!
  collection: Collection
  createdAt: Time!
  criteria: MarketplaceOrderCriteria
  expiresAt: Time!
  externalOfferSender: UserPublic
  filledQuantity: Decimal!
  id: ID!
  maker: UserOrBlockchainAddress!
  orderSide: MarketplaceOrderSide!
  price: Amount!
  quantity: Decimal!
  source: String!
  sourceOrderId: String!
  updatedAt: Time!
  usdPrice: Decimal!
}

type MarketplaceOrderConnection {
  nodes: [MarketplaceOrder!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
}

type MarketplaceOrderCriteria {
  displayOnly: Boolean!
  kind: MarketplaceOrderCriteriaKind!
  numericTraits: [MarketplaceOrderNumericTrait!]!
  traitMode: MarketplaceOrderTraitCriteriaMode
  traits: [MarketplaceOrderTrait!]!
}

enum MarketplaceOrderCriteriaKind {
  COLLECTION
  TOKEN
  TRAIT
}

input MarketplaceOrderFilter {
  artworkId: String
  asset: AssetInput
  collectionId: String
  openseaSlug: String
  side: MarketplaceOrderSide!
  token: MarketplaceOrderTokenFilter
}

type MarketplaceOrderNumericTrait {
  maxValue: Decimal
  minValue: Decimal
  type: String!
}

enum MarketplaceOrderSide {
  ASK
  BID
}

input MarketplaceOrderTokenFilter {
  contractAddress: String!
  tokenId: String!
}

type MarketplaceOrderTrait {
  type: String!
  value: String!
}

enum MarketplaceOrderTraitCriteriaMode {
  MULTI
  NUMERIC
  STRING
}

input MarketplaceOrdersRequest {
  after: Cursor
  filter: MarketplaceOrderFilter!
  first: Int = 20
}

type MarketplaceStats {
  period: MarketplaceStatsPeriod!
  topArtworksByVolume(filter: StatsFilter): [ArtworkVolume!]!
  topCollectionsByVolume(filter: StatsFilter): [CollectionVolume!]!
  topSales(filter: StatsFilter): [StatsSale!]!
}

enum MarketplaceStatsPeriod {
  PERIOD_1D
  PERIOD_7D
  PERIOD_30D
  PERIOD_ALL_TIME
}

type MintPassConfiguration {
  requiredArtworks: [Artwork!]!
}

enum MintingOptionType {
  DEFAULT
  FAST
}

type OpenseaListing {
  artwork: Artwork!
  chain: Chain!
  edition: Edition!
  endsAt: Time!
  id: String!
  listingType: OpenseaListingType!
  price: Amount!
  startsAt: Time!
}

enum OpenseaListingType {
  BASIC
  DUTCH
  ENGLISH
}

type PMAuctionBracket {
  from: Decimal!
  step: Decimal!
}

type PMAuctionStats {
  bidsCount: Int!
  highestBid: PrimaryMarketBid
}

"""Users always bid on 1/1 edition"""
type PMAuctionStrategy {
  auctionBrackets: [PMAuctionBracket!]
  currentStep: Decimal
  entryBid: Amount
  extensionSettings: ExtensionSettings
  lowestWinningBid: PrimaryMarketBid
  minimumBid: Amount!
  pmListingId: ID!
  rankedAuctionSettings: RankedAuctionSettings
  stats: PMAuctionStats!
}

"""
Buy Now Limited Edition Strategy, users can buy until editions are depleted  (up to `n` editions, `n` >= 1)
"""
type PMBuyNowLimitedEditionStrategy {
  decreasingSupply: DecreasingSupplySettings
  dutchAuction: DutchAuctionSettings
  maxEditions: Int!
  pmListingId: ID!
  price: Amount!
  stats: PMBuyNowStats!
}

"""
Buy Now Open Edition Strategy, users can buy until there is still some time left
"""
type PMBuyNowOpenEditionStrategy {
  dutchAuction: DutchAuctionSettings
  pmListingId: ID!
  price: Amount!
  stats: PMBuyNowStats!
}

type PMBuyNowStats {
  issuedEditions: Int!
}

enum PMListingEndReason {
  SOLD_OUT
  TIME_IS_OUT
}

type PageInfo {
  endCursor: Cursor
  hasNextPage: Boolean!
  hasPreviousPage: Boolean!
  startCursor: Cursor
}

type Person {
  banner: ImageAsset
  bio: Markdown
  bioLine: String
  birthYear: String
  categoriesTags: [String!]!
  cover: ImageAsset
  deathYear: String
  id: PersonID!
  isArtist: Boolean!
  isCurator: Boolean!
  isGallery: Boolean!
  location: String
  name: String
  profileLinks: [String!]!
  slug: String!
  twitterHandle: String
  updatedAt: Time
}

type PersonConnection {
  nodes: [Person!]!
  pageInfo: PageInfo!
  totalCount: Int
}

scalar PersonID

enum PersonSort {
  LASTNAME
  NAME
  UPDATED_AT
}

input PersonSorting {
  direction: SortDirection!
  sort: PersonSort!
}

enum PersonType {
  ARTIST
  BOTH
  CURATOR
  GALLERY
}

input PersonsPageFilter {
  categoriesTags: [String!]
  ids: [ID!]
  personTypes: [PersonType!]
  search: String
  slugs: [String!]
}

input PersonsPageRequest {
  after: Cursor
  filter: PersonsPageFilter
  first: Int! = 20
  sorting: PersonSorting
}

type PossibleStringFeatureValue {
  numberOfEntries: Int!
  value: String!
}

input PreviewUserInput {
  key: String!
  value: String!
}

"""Bid for primary market Bid Strategy"""
type PrimaryMarketBid {
  amount: Amount!
  bidder: UserPublic!
  createdAt: Time!
  id: ID!
}

type PrimaryMarketListing {
  """There is always one primary listing for one artwork"""
  artwork: Artwork!
  createdAt: Time!
  editionTarget: Edition
  endReason: PMListingEndReason

  """
  Primary market listing end reasons:
  * auction has ended
  * buy now editions depleted
  * open editions buy time has ended
  """
  endedAt: Time
  endsAt: Time!
  id: ID!
  startedAt: Time
  startsAt: Time!

  """Selected strategy for this primary market listing"""
  strategy: PrimaryMarketStrategy!
}

""""Proof" of buying (or winning) something on primary market"""
type PrimaryMarketSale {
  """Zero or null amount for raffle I suppose?"""
  amount: Amount!

  """Buyer becomes an owner of edition"""
  buyerId: ID!
  createdAt: Time!
  edition: Edition

  """Sale links to some edition"""
  editionId: ID
  finishedAt: Time
  id: ID!
  pmListing: PrimaryMarketListing!
  status: PrimaryMarketSaleStatus!
}

enum PrimaryMarketSaleStatus {
  FAILED
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
}

"""Each strategy would generate a PrimaryMarketSale"""
union PrimaryMarketStrategy = PMAuctionStrategy | PMBuyNowLimitedEditionStrategy | PMBuyNowOpenEditionStrategy

enum ProductChain {
  BASE
  BITCOIN
  ETHEREUM
  NONE
  PHYSICAL
  SEPOLIA
  SHAPE
  SOLANA
  TEZOS
}

type ProjectArtworkKind {
  allowUserSelection: Boolean!
  artworkId: ArtworkID!
  withRepetitions: Boolean!
}

type QuasiDragonsCompositeArtworkKind {
  artworkId: String!
  baseTileArtworkId: String!
  compositeBuilderIframeUrl: String!
  generatorIframeUrl: String!
}

type Query {
  activityPage(after: Cursor, filter: ActivityPageFilter, first: Int!): ActivityEntryConnection!
  artworksPage(request: ArtworksPageRequest!): ArtworkConnection!
  asset(assetType: AssetType!, id: ID!): Asset
  assetsPage(after: Cursor, filter: AssetFilter, first: Int!, sorting: AssetSorting): AssetConnection!
  collectionsPage(request: CollectionsPageRequest!): CollectionConnection!
  editionByContract(chain: ProductChain, contractAddress: String!, tokenId: String!): Edition
  editionByNumber(artworkId: ID!, editionNumber: String!): Edition
  estimateSecondaryMarketFees(artworkId: ID!, assetType: AssetType! = EDITION, price: InputAmount!): FeeEstimation!
  exhibitionsPage(request: ExhibitionsPageRequest!): ExhibitionConnection!
  explore(after: Cursor, filter: ExploreFilter, first: Int! = 20, sorting: ExploreSorting): CollectionConnection!
  galleriesPage(request: GalleriesPageRequest!): GalleryConnection!
  linksPage(request: LinksPageRequest!): LinkConnection!
  mintPassConfiguration(pmListingId: ID!): MintPassConfiguration!
  orders(request: MarketplaceOrdersRequest!): MarketplaceOrderConnection!
  personsPage(request: PersonsPageRequest!): PersonConnection!

  """
  Return the active or most recent primary market listing for an artwork.
  """
  primaryMarketListing(artworkId: ID!): PrimaryMarketListing

  """Return specific pm sale"""
  primaryMarketSale(pmSaleId: ID!): PrimaryMarketSale!
  projectStaticAssetByHash(artworkId: ArtworkID!, editionNumber: Int, hash: String!, totalEditions: Int, userInput: [PreviewUserInput!]): StaticAsset!
  reverseResolveENS(addresses: [String!]!): [String!]!
  search(query: String!): SearchResult!

  """
  Search usernames with spacing and typo tolerance. Returns up to 20 matches.
  """
  searchUsers(first: Int! = 10, query: String!): [UserPublic!]!

  """Return specific sm sale"""
  secondaryMarketSale(smSaleId: ID!): SecondaryMarketSale!
  stats(period: MarketplaceStatsPeriod!): MarketplaceStats!
  userById(id: String!): UserPublic
  userByLinkedWallet(address: String!, network: LinkedWalletNetwork!): UserPublic

  """Lookup user by username."""
  userByUsername(username: String!): UserPublic
  usersByLinkedWallet(addresses: [String]!, network: LinkedWalletNetwork!): [UserPublic]!
}

type RankedAuctionSettings {
  topNWinners: Int!
}

type SMBuyNowStrategy {
  price: Amount!
}

type SVGAsset implements IStaticAsset {
  author: String
  baseUrlTemplate: String!
  caption: String
  fileSize: Int
  id: StaticAssetID!
  mimeType: String
  previewAspectRatio: Float
  previewImageUrlTemplate: String!
}

type SearchResult {
  artists: [Person!]!
  collections: [Collection!]!
  exhibitions: [Exhibition!]!
}

type SecondaryMarketListing {
  additionalStrategies: [AdditionalSecondaryMarketStrategy!]!
  artwork: Artwork!
  asset: Asset!
  createdAt: Time!
  edition: Edition
  endedAt: Time
  id: ID!
  isActive: Boolean!
  listedAt: Time
  owner: UserPublic!
}

type SecondaryMarketSale {
  amount: Amount!
  asset: Asset!

  """Buyer becomes a new owner of edition"""
  buyerId: ID!
  createdAt: Time!

  """
  deprecated: use asset field
  Sale is associated with an edition. Change of ownership happens after the sale
  """
  editionId: ID
  finishedAt: Time
  id: ID!
  smListing: SecondaryMarketListing!
  status: SecondaryMarketSaleStatus!
}

enum SecondaryMarketSaleStatus {
  FAILED
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
}

type SolanaAddress implements BlockchainAddress {
  address: String!
}

enum SortDirection {
  ASC
  DESC
}

union StaticAsset = AudioAsset | IFrameAsset | ImageAsset | SVGAsset | VideoAsset

scalar StaticAssetID

input StatsFilter {
  tags: TagsFilter
}

type StatsSale {
  amount: Amount!
  artwork: Artwork!
  asset: Asset!
  buyer: UserPublic
  buyerBlockchainAddress: BlockchainAddress
  collection: Collection
  id: ID!
